text_blocks.snippet: Sovereign Silver is a brand name for Bio-Active Silver Hydrosol, a dietary supplement marketed for immune support. It is a colloidal silver product, meaning it contains tiny particles of silver suspended in liquid, specifically purified water. Sovereign Silver is known for its small particle size, high positive charge, and purity.

list.title: Bio-Active Silver Hydrosol:
list.snippet: This is the specific type of colloidal silver that Sovereign Silver produces.

list.title: Colloidal Silver:
list.snippet: A colloid is a substance where particles of one material are dispersed throughout another. In this case, silver particles are dispersed in water.
Small Particle Size: Sovereign Silver boasts a very small average particle size of 0.8 nanometers, which is said to allow for easier absorption by the body.
High Positive Charge: The product contains a high percentage of positively charged silver ions, which are claimed to make it more effective.
Purity: Sovereign Silver is made with 99.999% pure silver and pharmaceutical-grade purified water.

list.title: Safety:
list.snippet: Sovereign Silver is formulated to be safe for the whole family when used as directed, with a low concentration of 10 ppm (parts per million). It is claimed to be safe even with long-term use.

list.title: Manufacturing:
list.snippet: The product is manufactured by Natural Immunogenics, a family-owned business.

list.title: Alternative to Colloidal Silver:
list.snippet: It's worth noting that some sources differentiate between colloidal silver (containing silver particles) and ionic silver (containing silver ions). Sovereign Silver is a hydrosol, which is a specific type of colloidal silver.
